name: Hierarchical
description: Traditional top-down structure with clear chain of command and defined reporting relationships.
mainBenefit: Clear authority and decision-making pathways with well-defined roles and responsibilities.
mainWeakness: Slow decision-making and limited cross-functional collaboration; can stifle innovation and agility.
bestFor: Established organizations with stable operations requiring clear accountability and standardized processes.

name: Divisional
description: Semi-autonomous units organized by product, market, or geography, each with dedicated resources.
mainBenefit: Focused accountability and market responsiveness with dedicated resources per division.
mainWeakness: Resource duplication across divisions and potential silos that limit knowledge sharing.
bestFor: Multi-product companies or organizations serving distinct markets requiring localized decision-making.

name: Flat
description: Minimal hierarchy with few or no middle management layers, emphasizing autonomy and collaboration.
mainBenefit: Fast decision-making, high autonomy, and direct communication across all levels.
mainWeakness: Unclear accountability and difficult to scale beyond small teams; potential for role confusion.
bestFor: Startups and small teams prioritizing speed, innovation, and employee empowerment.

name: Matrix
description: Dual reporting structure where employees report to both functional managers and project/product leaders.
mainBenefit: Flexible resource allocation and strong cross-functional collaboration on complex initiatives.
mainWeakness: Conflicting priorities between managers and increased complexity in decision-making.
bestFor: Project-driven organizations requiring deep expertise and cross-functional coordination.

name: Network/Flatarchic
description: Flexible ecosystem combining flat team autonomy with strategic coordination through minimal structure.
mainBenefit: Maximum agility and adaptability with distributed decision-making and collaborative problem-solving.
mainWeakness: Requires high trust, strong culture, and sophisticated communication systems to function effectively.
bestFor: Modern organizations embracing remote work, rapid innovation, and autonomous team structures.
